title: Real-world context library
summary: Pickable themes (sport, current-events, music, film, local-region, pop-culture, science-news, sustainability) that bias the AI prompt's worked-example contexts. Builds on the curriculum-authority preamble's UK-context whitelist; adds a teacher-pickable filter on the Worksheets form. Pure data + one prompt-block extension.

in: client/src/data/contexts/realWorldContexts.json (new, ~200 entries) — { id, name, category, suggestedFor: subject[], examples: string[], avoidWith?: sendNeed[] }
client/src/lib/promptSections/realWorldContextDirective.ts (new, ~60 LoC) — prompt block injected when teacher picks a context
client/src/pages/Worksheets.tsx — new 'Real-world context (optional)' picker on the form
Targeted vitest: context picker honours sendNeed avoidWith list; LLM prompt block is well-formed
out: Auto-detection of 'currently trending' contexts (deferred — needs a content moderation review)
School-supplied custom contexts (deferred — admin-only feature for v2)

acceptance_criteria: Each context lists at least 3 examples a teacher can preview.
Picking 'Premier League football' biases the AI to use football examples in maths word problems / English creative writing prompts (verifiable via eval-harness fixture).
Contexts with avoidWith=['anxiety'] are excluded from the picker when the SEND profile is anxiety/SEMH.
Picker shows 'No context (default)' as the first option — backwards compatible.
tsc --noEmit clean; npm test passes; npm run eval:worksheets passes.

risk_register.risk: Sensitive contexts (e.g. 'war in Ukraine', 'celebrity scandal') slip into the curated list
risk_register.mitigation: Every context in the JSON file requires a maintainer signoff; CI checker scripts/check-context-library.mjs blocks any context with disallowed-list keywords.
Each context has a freshness field (evergreen | seasonal | dated); dated contexts hide after their expiry month.

related: G3 — lesson archetypes (archetype + context combine well, e.g. 'Do-Now on Premier League stats')
